The labeled ISGL exterior photo, official 1022 1st St. address, Purdue Engineering 2022 event page (ISGL venue at 1022 First St., with Muslim Student Association participation), and Tippecanoe County judgments listing North American Islamic Trust Inc. ISGL at 1022 First St. corroborate the site relationship. The GIS feature itself remains labeled Muslim Student Association / 1021 First St.; no parcel/name crosswalk was found.
